svg.title: Prompt tokens of each run against the number of tools
svg.desc: Two dot charts of the prompt tokens of each run, on a log scale, at 5, 20, 50 and 100 tools, without the selector in blue and with LLMToolSelectorMiddleware in plum. On Claude Haiku 5.5 the median run sent 7381, 12959, 25767, 44645 tokens without the selector and 10941, 14391, 20722, 33277 with it, in 5, 4.5, 4.5, 4.5 and 9, 9, 9, 10 model calls. With prompt caching the ten runs at 100 tools cost $0.016 without the selector and $0.033 with it. On Qwen3 4B the selector cut the tokens, and the runs failed instead.
svg.text: A. BILLED FOR 10 RUNS, WITH PROMPT CACHING
